spec.name: Furniture Haunted Throne
spec.description: A tall, grounded throne of weathered dark oak with plum upholstery, carved bone finials and a stepped bat crest. Connected construction, front facing negative Z, cushion top at y=14. All geometry is axis-aligned within the requested margins; each part has a separate cube-net UV region.

prompt: Create an original vanilla Minecraft furniture model: tall haunted throne with purple cushion, bone colored finials and bat crest. Grounded attractive survival-server furniture. Entire model fits x=0..16, y=0..32, z=0..16; floor y=0, front negative Z. 16 units per Minecraft block. Keep a 0.25-unit margin at outer x/z edges. Seat cushion top must be at y=14 so a player can sit on it. Use 8-30 purposeful axis-aligned cuboids, no rotations, no bones, no animation. Detailed hand-painted pixel art, coherent palette, explicit non-overlapping cube-net UVs with correct texel density. Connected physical structure, no z fighting, no stand outside the furniture. No text labels, no surrounding scene. Generate the whole piece with its distinctive silhouette and materials.
